name: hv15_dbk_cl-real2330-COMMIT
purpose: hb_dbk wires-only cluster ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks, ONE master for the four stacks (stk[1:0] strap pin): 8 closed native-PASS geo1 landing banks + the stk-strap DMA controller at the H-DIE v7 grant homes (511.92 x 360.72), nine clock entries (clk, clk_bank[7:0]), parent = wires only; actual new controller view and all parent PG/hop/native checks required.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_DBK_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp_banks.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_cl/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_cl/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_cl --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks --macro-view physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_bank/views/ot_hgi_dma_back_landing_bank --macro-view physical/ref_tile/hv15_dbk_vp4_ctl/views/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_controller > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
